sloka: तदा तदन्त:पुरमुज्झितप्रभं सुरैरिवोत्सृष्टमभास्करं दिनम् ।निरीक्ष्य सर्वन्तु विविक्तमात्मवान् मुमोच बाष्पं भरत: सुदु:खित: ॥ २.११४.३१ ॥
transliteration: tadā tadanta:puramujjhitaprabhaṁ surairivotsṛṣṭamabhāskaraṁ dinam ।nirīkṣya sarvantu viviktamātmavān mumoca bāṣpaṁ bharata: sudu:khita: ॥ 2.114.31 ॥

translations.english: Thus mourning in several ways, Bharata entered his fathers' palace (now) bereft of the king like a cave without the lion.
